final_questions.q1_best_candidate: Signal 3 (line_obs >= 3 AND NOT fig → KEEP_SEPARATE) — highest coverage (93%), 0 FP, 4 docs, but needs boundary overcommit fix
final_questions.q2_close_permanently: Signal 1 (has_fig_prefix → MERGE) — n=2, 1 doc, KEYWORD_RECURRENCE. Signal 2 merges into Signal 3.
final_questions.q4_min_independence: Level B minimum (different document), at least 10 future cases. Level A (different doc + different page) preferred.
final_questions.q5_minimal_feedback: YES — Human only provides KEEP_SEPARATE / MERGE / UNKNOWN. No rules, no features, no descriptions. UNKNOWN is critical.
final_questions.q6_need_rationale: NO — rationale for post-hoc analysis only. Signal discovery needs only LABELS.
final_questions.q7_need_llm: NO — all signals based on deterministic features. No semantic understanding needed.
final_questions.q8_need_new_architecture: NO — all features exist in P1/P2 or derivable. Consumer/Integration Gap is IS-11 issue, not architecture issue.
